guards: Secret(vault_key='demo_key', message='API key', kind='password', default=None, generate=False)
unit:
[Unit]
Description=Demo service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/srv/demo/current
# The service sees the filesystem read-only, except the state directories it declares
# (never the app root, which holds the releases), and has no /home and a private /tmp.
# ProtectKernelModules and CapabilityBoundingSet are left out: a user manager cannot
# drop capabilities, and a unit that asks fails to start with status 218.
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/srv/demo/data /srv/demo/config
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
# uv keeps a cache under $HOME, which the service cannot see.
Environment="UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache"
Environment="MODE=prod"
Environment="DEMO_HOST=<vault:demo_host>"
ExecStart=uv run --no-sync demo serve --host ${DEMO_HOST}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
